about: Seamless hand-painted-style colour maps any style can tint. Painted around a warm neutral grey (mean ~0.6); `materials.py use` tints them to a style profile. Rebuild with `materials.py build` (deterministic painter).
author: iamar kit
origin: original: every pixel is painted by kit/tools/paint_materials.py from periodic noise and block layouts; no photographs, no third-party textures, no generated-model input
licence: iamar project licence (not yet chosen by the maintainer: kit/inventory/licences.json row original-procedural). Free to use in iamar worlds.
evidence: the iamar browser source (not public) scripts/world/masterplan/mp_materials.gd header (13 painted layers incl. the trim sheet, 256 px per metre, warm balance) and docs/MASTERPLAN_ART_TECHNIQUES.md; kit/tools/paint_materials.py

rule.why: The city paints every near surface at 256 px/m (1024 px per 4 m tile); a surface under ~205 px/m looks blurry beside it. Far LODs (LOD1..LOD9) are seen from 30 m and more and need a quarter. Above 1024 px/m nobody can see the texels.
rule.how: UV-map at 4 m per UV unit (Blender: 1 UV unit = 4 m) with a 1024 px library map; primitives and terrain layers: uv_scale 4 with a 1024 px map.

budget.why: The whole city draws its buildings with 13 shared 1024 px layers (52 MiB at w x h x 4). A world that shares library maps stays near that; a generated building embeds about 17 MiB of its own (kit/style/lighting/README.md), so four of them already pass 64 MiB. The manifest's texture_bytes and texture_size are checked as well (the browser refuses a world over them).

stone.roles: small coursed rubble stone: ground storeys, walls, garden walls

ashlar.roles: big dressed pale ashlar: civic ground storeys, quoins, arches

granite.roles: rough dark granite: fortifications, heavy plinths

plaster.roles: lime plaster with stains: upper storeys, interiors

timber.roles: oak planks, grain along u: frames, beams, doors, floors

slate.roles: slate roof; v runs down the slope (image top = ridge)

slate_dark.roles: heavy dark slate roof; v down the slope

glazed.roles: glazed barrel roof tiles; v down the slope

shingle.roles: mossy wooden shingles; v down the slope

iron.roles: hammered iron plate with rivets: straps, hinges, lamps, gates

trim.roles: trim sheet: 8 horizontal strips (cornice, frame, moulding, carved, dentil, rope, beam, strap), each 1/8 of the height, tiling along u; map a moulding's UVs onto one strip instead of modelling it

grass.roles: meadow, lawn and hill terrain bands; ground with no direction

sand.roles: sand, dust and dry-ground terrain bands (ripples run along u)
